critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: YearInPixels.jsx line 65 renders a flex row of 53 children with scrollWidth=739 inside a 336px .glass-card container on mobile. Since document.body.scrollWidth stays at viewport width (390), it is contained (no page-level horizontal scroll) — likely via overflow:auto/hidden on the parent card. If overflow-x scroll is intentional (calendar), fine; otherwise consider flex-wrap or a compact mobile layout to remove the internal 400px scrollable region.

InspirationScreen ('cliquez n'importe où pour continuer') still appears on first mobile navigation even with localStorage.zayado_onboarding_seen='1'. Uses sessionStorage flags; add zayado_inspiration_seen/dismissed to skip in E2E — added by testing agent locally. Consider unifying flag naming.
Cockpit empty-state copy on mobile is well-designed (matches E1 note that Thomas has no data). No contrast issues observed in light or dark themes.
